description: Solo developer from Ukraine building SEED, a Unity game for the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge. You are the surviving code of a crashed Mars probe: rebuild yourself from Martian matter, build an outpost and keep the crew alive through solar flares, dust storms and night. Mechanics are based on real NASA data (MOXIE, Curiosity RAD, Phoenix). Skills: C#, Unity, game design. Team is complete.
